resources.string: Paste a Cloudflare API token. Virga checks it with Cloudflare, then keeps it encrypted on this device. The token is sent only to api.cloudflare.com.
The demo uses sample data. You do not need a token.
Create an API token, copy it, and paste it into the field.
Read-only variant: view everything, change nothing
Names follow Cloudflare\'s permissions reference and may change. Give only what you need. Start with the read-only list if you are unsure.
Workers Builds needs a user token. Create it under My Profile, then API Tokens. An account-owned token is refused by the Builds API (\"Invalid token\").
R2 object browsing, upload and delete need an R2 API token with Admin Read and Write, made in the R2 dashboard. The permissions above cover buckets and settings only.

string-array.name: account_guidance_steps
string-array.item: 1. Open the API tokens page in your browser and choose Create Token.
2. Start from a custom token. Give it a name you will recognise.
3. Add the permissions below, choose the accounts and zones, then create the token.
4. Copy the token. Cloudflare shows it once. Paste it here.

string-array.name: account_guidance_permissions
string-array.item: Account Settings: Read (lists your accounts)
Zone: Read and Zone: Edit (list, create, delete and pause zones)
Zone Settings: Edit (development mode)
Cache Purge: Purge (purge a zone\'s cache)
DNS: Edit (records, import and export, DNSSEC)
Workers Routes: Edit (Worker routes on a zone)
Workers Scripts: Edit (Workers, versions, deployments, secrets, custom domains)
Workers CI: Edit (Workers Builds: builds, triggers, build settings, cancel)
Pages: Edit (Pages projects, deployments and domains)
Workers R2 Storage: Edit (R2 buckets, CORS, lifecycle, lock and custom domains)
D1: Edit (databases, SQL, export and time travel)
Workers KV Storage: Edit (KV namespaces and keys)
Account Analytics: Read (Worker and KV analytics)
Zone: Analytics Read (zone traffic)
Registrar Domains: Read (registrar details on zones)

string-array.name: account_guidance_read_only_permissions
string-array.item: Account Settings: Read
Zone: Read and Zone: Analytics Read
Zone Settings: Read
DNS: Read
Workers Routes: Read
Workers Scripts: Read
Workers CI: Read
Pages: Read
Workers R2 Storage: Read
D1: Read
Workers KV Storage: Read
Account Analytics: Read
Registrar Domains: Read

resources.string: This token cannot see any Cloudflare accounts.
Removes the token and cached accounts from this device
The token is deleted from this device. You will need to paste it again to sign in. Nothing is revoked at Cloudflare.
